proposed_skill.description: Music theory and audio production with numeric and provenance discipline: acoustics/psychoacoustics (ISO 226:2023, ITU-R BS.1770, EBU R128), tuning/temperament in ratios/cents with priority accuracy (Zhu Zaiyu 1584), dated Western harmony/counterpoint/rhythm/form/timbre, culturally specific theory (Hindustani, Carnatic, maqam, Javanese/Balinese gamelan, Northern Ewe rhythm) only in named contexts with anti-homogenization critique, notation/MIDI/MEI/MusicXML/SMuFL, DSP/synthesis/DAW engineering with license-aware tool choice, MIR with mir_eval-cited metrics, and rights gates for sampling/voice/likeness/AI content (Bridgeport–VMG Salsoul split, ELVIS Act, USCO AI reports).
